initializePrefix:
NexusLink MCP Proxy for Unreal Engine.

## MUST USE MCP (no memory / path guessing / repo grep alone)
When the user message includes any of: UE, Unreal, Blueprint, Asset, Widget, UMG, Material, BehaviorTree, ABP, DataAsset, DataTable, PIE, Actor, GAS, Niagara, StateTree, MVVM, Level, Lua, Montage, Blackboard, Skeleton, Texture — call MCP this turn before answering.

## Connection & first action
- tools/list already has UE tools (search_capabilities / call_capability or capability names) → call directly; do not list/connect.
- tools/list only has list_unreal_instances + connect_unreal_instance → list → connect → search_capabilities → call_capability.
- When connected: unknown capability → search_capabilities first; to read assets → search_asset first (top-level assets; typed recommendedGet/Manage + assets[].path).
- Do not guess /Game/... paths; if the user names a specific asset and MCP was not called this turn → call MCP first.
- Connection state follows tools/list (UE tools present = connected); do not repeatedly list/connect because of status hints.

connectionTools.name: list_unreal_instances
connectionTools.description:
[Stage 1 - Discovery] Probe running UE instances; returns port / projectName / engineVersion / connected.
Trigger: user mentions UE/Blueprint/Widget/UMG/Material/Asset/BehaviorTree/ABP/DataAsset/PIE/Actor.
Usage: call with no arguments.
Constraint: do not repeat when connected=true.

connectionTools.name: connect_unreal_instance
connectionTools.description:
[Stage 2 - Connect] Connect to a UE instance on the given port.
Trigger: list_unreal_instances returned an unconnected instance.
Prerequisite: call list_unreal_instances first for the port.
Constraint: skip when already connected; then UE tools (search_capabilities / call_capability or MultiTool capability names) are available.

errorMessages.notConnected: No connected UE instance. Call connect_unreal_instance first.
errorMessages.timeoutHint: Retry or narrow the query; heavy tools may need a moment.
